(()=>{
  const checks={};
  const near=(a,b)=>Math.abs(a-b)<.031;
  const shifts=[['0px',0],['4px',4],['-4.5px',-4.5],['0.5em',10],['-0.125em',-2.5],['25%',7.5],['-50%',-15],['calc(10% + .25em)',8],['100px',100],['-100px',-100]];
  const make=(kind,shift)=>{
    const root=document.createElement('section');root.style.cssText='display:block;width:240px;margin:0;padding:0;border:0;font:16px/24px "Liberation Sans"';
    const node=kind==='svg'?document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','svg'):document.createElement(kind);
    node.style.cssText='display:inline-block;width:32px;height:24px;margin:3px 7px 5px;padding:0;border:0;font:20px/30px "Liberation Sans";vertical-align:'+shift;
    if(kind==='img'){node.width=32;node.height=24;}
    if(kind==='div'){node.style.display='inline-flex';node.style.width='auto';node.style.height='auto';node.textContent='Aa';}
    const marker=document.createElement('span');marker.style.cssText='display:inline-block;width:0;height:0;margin:0;padding:0;border:0';
    root.append(node,marker);document.body.append(root);return {root,node,marker};
  };
  const reference=make('span','baseline');reference.node.remove();
  const parentRect=reference.root.getBoundingClientRect(),markerRect=reference.marker.getBoundingClientRect();
  const parentBaseline=markerRect.y-parentRect.y,parentDescent=parentRect.height-parentBaseline;reference.root.remove();
  const verify=({root,node,marker},baseline,shift,width,height)=>{
    const r=root.getBoundingClientRect(),n=node.getBoundingClientRect(),m=marker.getBoundingClientRect();
    const ascent=Math.max(parentBaseline,3+baseline+shift),descent=Math.max(parentDescent,height+5-baseline-shift);
    return near(r.height,ascent+descent)&&near(n.y-r.y,ascent-baseline-shift)&&near(m.y-r.y,ascent)&&near(n.width,width)&&near(n.height,height)&&near(n.x-r.x,7);
  };
  for(const kind of ['img','svg','div']){
    const original=make(kind,'baseline');
    const n=original.node.getBoundingClientRect(),m=original.marker.getBoundingClientRect();
    const baseline=m.y-n.y,width=n.width,height=n.height;
    checks[kind+':baseline']=kind==='div'?near(baseline,22):near(baseline,height+5);original.root.remove();
    for(const [css,shift] of shifts){
      const {root,node,marker}=make(kind,css);
      checks[kind+':'+css]=verify({root,node,marker},baseline,shift,width,height);
      root.remove();
    }
  }
  const live=make('svg','0.5em');
  checks.liveInitial=verify(live,29,10,32,24);
  live.node.style.fontSize='24px';checks.ownFontMutation=verify(live,29,12,32,24);
  live.node.style.verticalAlign='25%';live.node.style.lineHeight='40px';checks.ownLineMutation=verify(live,29,10,32,24);
  live.root.remove();document.body.append(live.root);checks.reattachment=verify(live,29,10,32,24);live.root.remove();
  const clipped=make('div','4px');clipped.node.style.cssText+=';overflow:hidden;width:32px;height:30px';
  checks.clippedFlex=verify(clipped,22,4,32,30);clipped.root.remove();
  const clippedBlock=make('div','4px');clippedBlock.node.style.cssText+=';display:inline-block;overflow:hidden;width:32px;height:30px';
  checks.clippedBlock=verify(clippedBlock,35,4,32,30);clippedBlock.root.remove();
  const wrapped=make('svg','4px');wrapped.marker.remove();wrapped.root.style.width='50px';
  const second=wrapped.node.cloneNode(true),third=wrapped.node.cloneNode(true);second.style.verticalAlign='-4px';third.style.verticalAlign='0px';wrapped.root.append(second,third);
  const row=shift=>Math.max(parentBaseline,32+shift)+Math.max(parentDescent,-shift);
  const r=wrapped.root.getBoundingClientRect(),a=wrapped.node.getBoundingClientRect(),b=second.getBoundingClientRect(),c=third.getBoundingClientRect();
  checks.wrapping=near(r.height,row(4)+row(-4)+row(0))&&near(a.y-r.y,3)&&near(b.y-r.y,row(4)+3)&&near(c.y-r.y,row(4)+row(-4)+3)&&near(a.x-r.x,7)&&near(b.x-r.x,7)&&near(c.x-r.x,7);wrapped.root.remove();
  return checks;
})()
